title: Comparatives & superlatives · 比较级与最高级
pattern: Adjective-er + than  the + adjective-est  more / most + adjective
summary: 两者比较用比较级加 than，三者以上比较用最高级；短词加 -er / -est，长词前加 more / most。
explanation: **比较级**用于两个事物之间的比较，后面接 **than**：My room is **bigger than** yours. **最高级**用于三个或三个以上事物中“最……”，前面要加定冠词 the：This river is **the longest** in the country. 中文的“更”“最”对应英语的比较级和最高级，但英语要加上 than 或 the。

**单音节词和以 -y 结尾的双音节词**加 -er / -est：tall → taller → the tallest；easy → easier → the easiest。以不发音的 e 结尾的词只加 -r / -st：nice → nicer。以“一个元音加一个辅音”结尾的单音节词要双写末尾辅音：big → bigger → the biggest，hot → hotter → the hottest。注意：单音节词不能和 more / most 同时使用。
**多音节词**（一般三个音节或更多，还有大部分双音节形容词）前面加 **more / most**：beautiful → more beautiful → the most beautiful；difficult → more difficult → the most difficult。中文学习者常常想当然地把 more 加在所有形容词前，这需要按音节数来判断。
**同等程度**用 **as ... as**，表示“和……一样”：She is **as tall as** her mother. 否定时用 not as ... as，表示“没有……那么”：This bag is not as heavy as that one. 注意 as...as 中间是形容词原形，不加比较级形式。
有几个词的比较级和最高级是**不规则**的，需要单独记：good → better → the best；bad → worse → the worst；far → farther / further → the farthest / furthest。其中 good 的比较级 better 最常用，中文“更好”就对应 better，不能说 more good。
mistakes: ✗ My sister is more tall than me. → ✓ My sister is taller than me. 单音节词用 -er，不要和 more 同时使用。
✗ This test is the most easy. → ✓ This test is the easiest. easy 是 -y 结尾的双音节词，最高级用 the easiest。
✗ My English is more good than yours. → ✓ My English is better than yours. good 的比较级是不规则形式 better。
✗ She is as tall than her brother. → ✓ She is as tall as her brother. 表示同等程度要用 as ... as，不用 than。

examples.text: My house is bigger than yours.
This river is the longest in the country.
English is more difficult than I expected.
She is as tall as her mother.
This is the best day of my life.
examples.translation: 这是我一生中最美好的一天。
examples.note: good 的最高级是不规则的 best。

examples.text: Public transport is often faster than driving in the city.
examples.translation: 在城市里，公共交通通常比开车快。

exercises.sentence: My new bag is ___ than my old one.
exercises.explanation: 单音节词 big 的比较级是 bigger，要双写 g 再加 -er。

exercises.sentence: This is ___ restaurant in the city.
exercises.explanation: expensive 是多音节词，最高级是 the most expensive。

exercises.translation: 今天的天气和昨天一样好。
exercises.explanation: 表示同等程度用 as good as。
fast 是单音节词，比较级用 faster，后接 than。

options: My English is more good than yours.
My English is better than yours.
My English is gooder than yours.
My English is best than yours.
exercises.explanation: good 的比较级是 better，后接 than。

exercises.source: 这是我见过的最有趣的电影。
options: This is the interestingest film I have ever seen.
This is the most interesting film I have ever seen.
This is most interesting film I have ever seen.
This is the more interesting film I have ever seen.
exercises.explanation: interesting 是多音节词，最高级用 the most interesting。

options: This road is more narrow than that one.
She is as clever as her sister.
exercises.explanation: narrow 是单音节词，比较级应写成 narrower。

options: It is the hottest day this year.
This exam is the most easy.
Our house is bigger than theirs.
exercises.explanation: easy 的最高级是 the easiest，不能用 the most easy。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 这是我今年吃过的最好的一餐。
exercises.explanation: good 的最高级 the best，修饰 meal 后接定语从句 I've had this year。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 我哥哥和我爸爸一样高。
exercises.explanation: 同等程度的结构是 as + 形容词原形 + as。
